sections.introduction: Mukta Shukti Pishti is a classical preparation, having sweet and pungent taste. This Ayurvedic product is prepared from pearl oyster shell. This is a potent form to get calcium. It is available in powder form (Pishti) which is a very fine Ayurvedic treatment for conditions like gastritis, abdominal pain and respiratory conditions.
sections.ingredients:
Mukta Shukti – Pearl oyster 
 Lemon juice and rose water. 

 Method of Preparation 
 Crush Pearl oyster into coarse form powder. Then it is subjected to a process called Swedana in lemon juice. Then the soft powder is crushed with rose water to get a smooth fine powder further. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Mukta Shukti Pishti is an Ayurvedic medicine used to manage the various respiratory, heart and digestive complications. For respiratory complications, it helps to manage the various problems like bronchitis, asthma, cough etc. Natural ingredients used in this medicine are loaded with the decongestant and expectorant properties which help to clear the phlegm and mucous from air ways. It also helps to manage the problems like cough, chest and nasal congestion etc. Mukta Shukti Pishti works well to manage the heart problems. Cardiovascular properties of this medicine help to strengthen the heart muscles. On the other hand, it also helps to maintain healthy blood pressure and cholesterol levels in the body. For the digestive complications, mukta shukti pishti is considered as an effective medicine. It helps to improve the digestion power and creates the calming effects. It also resolves the various problems like bloating, flatulence, heartburn, indigestion, acidity, nausea, vomiting etc. Healing action of this medicine is quite good for the peptic ulcers and gastritis.
sections.therapeutic_uses:
It is helpful in treating conditions like bronchitis, heart diseases. 
 It is also efficient to use in getting relief from abdominal pain, gastritis, diarrhea, acid, peptic disorders. 
 Its other uses are like in case of toxic conditions and spleen related diseases. 
 Its sweet and pungent taste helps to improve digestion power and has calming effect over stomach.
sections.dosage: Consume 250 – 500 mg daily, in divided doses, usually before having meals. The dose and time of administration must be as per doctor’s suggestion.
sections.contraindications_side_effects:
Till now no known side effects with this product has been reported. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

Mukta Shukti Pishti – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Mukta Shukti Pishti is a classical preparation, having sweet and pungent taste. This Ayurvedic product is prepared from pearl oyster shell. This is a potent form to get calcium. It is available in powder form (Pishti) which is a very fine Ayurvedic treatment for conditions like gastritis, abdominal pain and respiratory conditions. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Mukta Shukti – Pearl oyster 
 Lemon juice and rose water. 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Crush Pearl oyster into coarse form powder. Then it is subjected to a process called Swedana in lemon juice. Then the soft powder is crushed with rose water to get a smooth fine powder further. 
 Medicinal Properties 
 Mukta Shukti Pishti is an Ayurvedic medicine used to manage the various respiratory, heart and digestive complications. For respiratory complications, it helps to manage the various problems like bronchitis, asthma, cough etc. Natural ingredients used in this medicine are loaded with the decongestant and expectorant properties which help to clear the phlegm and mucous from air ways. It also helps to manage the problems like cough, chest and nasal congestion etc. Mukta Shukti Pishti works well to manage the heart problems. Cardiovascular properties of this medicine help to strengthen the heart muscles. On the other hand, it also helps to maintain healthy blood pressure and cholesterol levels in the body. For the digestive complications, mukta shukti pishti is considered as an effective medicine. It helps to improve the digestion power and creates the calming effects. It also resolves the various problems like bloating, flatulence, heartburn, indigestion, acidity, nausea, vomiting etc. Healing action of this medicine is quite good for the peptic ulcers and gastritis. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 It is helpful in treating conditions like bronchitis, heart diseases. 
 It is also efficient to use in getting relief from abdominal pain, gastritis, diarrhea, acid, peptic disorders. 
 Its other uses are like in case of toxic conditions and spleen related diseases. 
 Its sweet and pungent taste helps to improve digestion power and has calming effect over stomach. 
 
 Dosage 
 Consume 250 – 500 mg daily, in divided doses, usually before having meals. The dose and time of administration must be as per doctor’s suggestion. 
 Contraindications/ Side Effects 
 Till now no known side effects with this product has been reported. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
